Both gaps are must-level with no candidate, so calibration rule 6 makes the overall verdict not_feasible. Clearing the access, licence and mapping conditions would not close the production humidity gap. The Chicago link (unreachable, US geography) and the Eurostat link (unknown licence, annual national context) are not feasible; neither is needed to close a must gap. No N5 patient-level source was found or opened.

No relative humidity source for the production window; Open-Meteo does not configure humidity and no other candidate supplies it.
Access, zero-count convention, district code list and suppression rule are undocumented; district cannot be joined to station geography yet.
Out of scope by brief. No candidate was opened or profiled. The clinic table is described as containing no patient identifiers and has no excluded terms, so no N5 entry was flagged.
Eurostat licence unknown, covers only 2005 of the prototype window and no production years.
